headline: LEMMINGS-LITE learns to float
lede: The never-dry rung sent slot b to Lemmings, and the shelf got the parachute: the original's fifth skill now rides the panel, the pad and the sky — with the pond still very much able to drown you.

notes.text: FLOATER shipped (#3827): capped descent, no landing height is fatal, the canopy stays on show while walking as on the Amiga, and every later fall auto-opens it. Digit5 / L1 / panel; the solver still proves every level with the four original mechanics, so all existing proofs and slack ride unchanged.
Red main cleared on the way: watchpillcheck was failing at main because two games' WATCH pills parked under the toast default (#3826/#3830) — fixed at the source, merged as #3838 before the game PR.

The kick itself was a phantom — one game's issue body said "per the Lemmings convention" and the word-boundary matcher took the bait (evidence + a proposed title-only fix on #3440). The stage it pointed at was real work anyway.
Lemmings now has a README with honest gaps: BUILDER still missing, blockers never wake, ponds are static, and the attract demo has never opened a parachute.
